name: Ian Garry
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: An Irish welterweight (17-2, age 28) coming off a five-round decision loss to Islam Makhachev for the title at UFC 330 in August, four months before this fight. Before that he beat Carlos Prates and Belal Muhammad by decision. Both losses are five-round decisions (Rakhmonov, Makhachev). He opened about -185 and has drifted to around -145.

how_they_fight.Striking: A long, upright kickboxer with a sharp jab, kicks and good footwork. Eight knockouts in our data (three in R1, three in R2, one in R3), but recently he wins on points: his last five wins include four decisions.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Defensive wrestling has held up against strikers; Makhachev and Rakhmonov out-grappled him over five rounds.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped; never knocked down in the UFC in our data.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has gone five rounds three times (Rakhmonov, Prates, Makhachev) and stays busy.

patterns: Jab and kicks at range; wins on points against good opponents
Has gone five rounds three times
concerns: Both losses came to elite grapplers over five rounds
Quick turnaround after a five-round title loss
keys_to_beat: Wrestle him: chain takedowns and hold him down
Close distance behind feints and pressure

news.text: Opened -185 against Amosov and moved to about -145 (BetOnline).
